principles: Gate evidence must be mechanically bound to current material and validation
Degraded single-host evidence must not dilute independent-host quorum semantics
A documented recovery command must be executable as printed
drivers: Reject stale or caller-conflicting bindings before writing evidence

options.name: A: Explicit deriveBindings mode with shared helper
cons: Adds an explicit CLI flag and shared abstraction

options.name: B: Always auto-derive missing bindings
cons: Could turn accidental weak submissions into gate evidence

chosen: A: Explicit deriveBindings mode with shared helper
rationale: It fixes the mechanical contradiction while preserving legacy warnings and two-host independence. One canonical helper prevents quorum and degraded paths from drifting.

preMortem.scenario: Single-host and quorum derive different digests
preMortem.trigger: Helper omits a field or retains a different purpose/schema
preMortem.consequence: Valid fallback verdict remains ignored or quorum behavior regresses
preMortem.mitigation: Golden parity test using identical story evidence and host identity

preMortem.scenario: Caller supplies stale digest and derive mode silently overwrites it
preMortem.trigger: Precedence favors computed values without comparison
preMortem.consequence: Audit trail hides stale caller state
preMortem.mitigation: Compare every supplied binding with canonical value and fail before any write

preMortem.scenario: Explicit mode accidentally creates quorum-like assurance
preMortem.trigger: Single-host handler emits more than one host identity or changes requiredHosts
preMortem.mitigation: Emit exactly one verdict per call and test no second host is created

preMortem.trigger: Core command recipe is not updated with the new flag
preMortem.consequence: Users remain blocked despite helper implementation
preMortem.mitigation: Snapshot guidance command and execute it in focused integration coverage
